item.title: Taylor Swift’s Wedding Look Included a Subtle Eras Tour Nod
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music news! We're talking about the wedding of the year - Taylor Swift has tied the knot with Travis Kelce! Let's dive into the details of her stunning wedding look.
According to Swift's rep, the pop superstar wore a custom Christian Dior Haute Couture gown, designed by Jonathan Anderson, to her ceremony at Madison Square Garden in New York City. And that's not all - she also wore Cartier jewelry and custom Christian Louboutin shoes.
But here's a fun fact for Swifties: this isn't the first time Taylor has worn Christian Louboutin. She actually wore custom bejeweled styles from the designer throughout her European Eras Tour, featuring different silhouettes and colorways for each segment of the show.
The wedding ceremony itself was an intimate affair, with Swift's brother Austin serving as her man of honor and Jason Kelce as Travis' best man. And in a surprise twist, actor-comedian Adam Sandler officiated the ceremony!
Taylor and Travis' love story began in 2023, and the couple announced their engagement in August 2025. Swift has even penned several songs about their romance, including 'So High School' and 'The Alchemy'.
That's all for now - we can't wait to see the official photos of Taylor's bridal look. Congratulations to the happy couple!"
[Outro music plays]
